assessmentContext: Use these tasks for guided workplace rehearsal and evidence preparation. Occupational competence must be confirmed through the qualification's approved assessment process.
sourceNote: Original Evia practice tasks mapped to course criteria. These are not official awarding-body or end-point-assessment tasks and do not produce an official grade.

tasks.title: Set out the first thin-joint course
tasks.brief: Establish datums and set out the first course of a thin-joint block wall to the drawing.
resources: Current drawing, specification and manufacturer guidance
Laser or level, line, square and tape
Thin-joint applicator and maintained hand tools
Specified blocks, adhesive and ancillary components
safetyControls: Check the task information and safe system of work
Use the specified PPE and face-fit-tested RPE
Control silica dust when cutting blocks
Keep access, platforms and the work area clear

sequence.title: Check dimensions, diagonals, level and square
sequence.instruction: Check dimensions, diagonals, level and square

decision.prompt: A checkpoint reveals that the base varies beyond adhesive adjustment. What is the strongest response?
options: Pause at a safe point, correct the cause of the base varies beyond adhesive adjustment, then repeat the specified checks before continuing.
Continue and hide the issue during finishing.
Change the drawing or specification to match the work.
Leave it for the next trade without recording it.
decision.feedback: Correct the supporting bed or report the conflict before thin-joint work continues.

commonFaults: the base varies beyond adhesive adjustment
the opening is out of square
wall lines conflict with a service

questions.prompt: Why is “Establish datum and wall position” important on this task?
questions.guide: The first course controls all later thin joints, so base errors cannot be hidden safely.

questions.prompt: How would you check that this work meets the drawing or specification?
questions.guide: Use datum readings, line, level, square, dimensions and diagonals.

questions.prompt: What would you do if the base varies beyond adhesive adjustment?
questions.guide: Correct the supporting bed or report the conflict before thin-joint work continues.
